verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents some first-party batch capabilities: scheduled export of large data volumes to blob storage, experiments run across whole datasets, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluators applied to samples of live traffic. There is no documented general bulk-action capability (such as selecting many traces to tag, delete, score or add to a dataset in one action), and one hands-on user found the retrieval API 'brutally slow' for bulk scanning and had to query the database directly. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/annotate actions across selected items, bulk operations via API/CLI, and evidence that bulk reads perform well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
